item.description: The Reset Delivery Unit, under the Department of Prime Minister and National Executive Council, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Certified Practising Accountants Papua New Guinea (CPA PNC) to support the implementation of the PNG RESET@50 agenda. item.title: Tomorrow X Together holding Japan concerts to mark seventh anniversary, eighth EP
item.description: Boy band Tomorrow X Together will hold concerts in Japan in May and June to celebrate the seventh anniversary of its debut, BigHit Music said Thursday. Tomorrow X Together announced plans to start its “2026 TXT MOA Con In Japan” at noon on Thursday on the fan community platform Weverse. The group will stage eight shows in four cities, starting in Aichi on May 23 and 24, followed by Chiba on May 27 and 28, Fukuoka on June 16 and 17 and Hyogo on June 23 and 24. item.title: T-pop boy band BUS to hold fan concert in Korea this May
item.description: Thailand's T-pop boy band BUS is holding a fan concert in Korea in May as part of their first Asian fan concert tour, according to Live Nation Korea. The concert will take place on May 31 at Myunghwa Live Hall in Yeongdeungpo District, western Seoul, according to Live Nation Korea. BUS was formed through the television survival program “789 Survival,” which aired in Thailand in 2023.
